Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::countDownSuspensionDay() {
	definition:
		obs: Set(User) = User.allInstance()->select(u|u.LoanedBook->exists(l|l.OverDueFee>0))
	precondition:
		obs.size()>0
	postcondition:
		obs->forAll(u|u.SuspensionDays = u.SuspensionDays@pre-1) and
		obs->forAll(u|if u.SuspensionDays = 0 
		then u.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::SUSPEND 
		else true 
		endif )
}
